SMTO-SKL-0146 — SMTO lost its place in the Slack list

GUID: d2c28efc-bdc7-5eba-9cbc-2766d9ded7c0
Slug: slack-cursor-invalid
Domain: SKL · Subsystem: slack

What happened

  • SMTO was reading a long Slack list page by page, but its bookmark for the next page has expired or no longer matches the request. Nothing in Slack was changed.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Ask the Agent to read the list again from the beginning, with the same channel, workspace and filters as before. SMTO's bookmark for the next page only works for 15 minutes and only for the exact same request.
  2. Keep the same filters while you move through the pages. If you want different filters, start a new list instead of continuing. Changing the filters part-way through makes the old bookmark invalid.
  3. If SMTO was restarted while you were paging, simply start the list again. Restarting SMTO clears all saved places in Slack lists.

What success looks like

  • The Agent shows the first page of results again and can move on to the next pages without this error.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO if a fresh list still fails straight away.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • A Slack continuation cursor was rejected because it is unknown, older than 15 minutes, evicted, or bound to a different workspace, principal, method or filter set.

What this means

  • An opaque Slack continuation handle is absent, expired or bound to another workspace/operation/filter set. The diagnostic performs no Slack request. Inspect the original receipt and operation stage to determine effects; keep workspace, principal and exact channel/message identities fixed during recovery.

Why this can happen

  • An opaque Slack continuation handle is absent, expired or bound to another workspace/operation/filter set.

How to diagnose it

  • Compare the original workspace/query binding and fifteen-minute lifetime.

How to fix it

  • RateLimits.resolve_cursor accepts only in-memory cursors issued within 900 seconds for the identical identity/method/params binding; restarting the Server clears them. Restart the read without a cursor using the exact same workspace_ref and filters, then follow the newly returned cursors.
  • Restart the bounded read with the same exact workspace and filters; continuation handles expire after fifteen minutes.

Retry and execution caution

  • Inspect exact provider state and authority first.

How to verify the fix

  • A new bounded read uses the exact intended workspace and filters.

What not to do

  • Do not expose secrets or blindly replay uncertain mutations.

Technical notes

  • The diagnostic performs no Slack request. Inspect the original receipt and operation stage to determine effects; keep workspace, principal and exact channel/message identities fixed during recovery.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
